overview.description: The Miller Convertible Total Return ETF (MCVT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is actively managed, seeking income and capital appreciation through exposure to convertible bonds, including synthetic versions and similar instruments. Security selection is combines fundamental and quantitative research. MCVT was launched on Mar 24, 2026 and is issued by Miller.
